sections.title: Section 1: Notes on Social Programme
sections.instruction:
Questions 1-4: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
Questions 5-10: Complete the table below. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
sections.intro_text:
NOTES ON SOCIAL PROGRAMME

Example: Number of trips per month: 5

Visit places which have:
• Historical interest
• good 1: [blank]
• 2: [blank]

Cost: between £5.00 and £15.00 per person
Note: special trips organized for groups of 3: [blank] people
Time: departure - 8.30 a.m. | return - 6.00 p.m.
To reserve a seat: sign name on the 4: [blank] 3 days in advance

WEEKEND TRIPS TABLE:
• St Ives | Date: 5: [blank] | Seats: 16 | Optional extra: Hepworth Museum
• London | Date: 16th February | Seats: 45 | Optional extra: 6: [blank]
• 7: [blank] | Date: 3rd March | Seats: 18 | Optional extra: S.S. Great Britain
• Salisbury | Date: 18th March | Seats: 50 | Optional extra: Stonehenge
• Bath | Date: 23rd March | Seats: 16 | Optional extra: 8: [blank]

For further information:
Read the 9: [blank] or see Social Assistant: Jane 10: [blank]

questions.prompt: Visit places which have good 1: _________
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'places with a good variety of shopping'，考查生活娱乐词汇填写。
questions.location: places with a good variety of shopping

questions.prompt: Visit places which have: 2: _________
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'And we always make sure there are guided tours available'，导游/有向导的游览。
questions.location: make sure there are guided tours available

questions.prompt: special trips organized for groups of 3: _________ people
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'If we have more than 12 people wanting to go somewhere special'。
questions.location: more than 12 people wanting to go

questions.prompt: To reserve a seat: sign name on the 4: _________ 3 days in advance
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'You need to sign your name on the notice board'，布告栏。
questions.location: sign your name on the notice board

questions.prompt: St Ives Date: 5: _________
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'on the 13th of February, we're going to St Ives'。
questions.location: on the 13th of February, we're going to St Ives

questions.prompt: London Optional extra: 6: _________
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'the optional extra there is a visit to the Tower of London'，伦敦塔。
questions.location: a visit to the Tower of London

questions.prompt: Place: 7: _________ | Date: 3rd March | Seats: 18
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'on the 3rd of March, we're going to Bristol - transporting 18 people'，地名填写首字母大写。

questions.prompt: Bath Optional extra: 8: _________
questions.explanation: 录音中提及 Bath 的自选项目是参观 American Museum。

questions.prompt: Read the 9: _________ for further information
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'You can either read the student newspaper or talk directly to our Social Assistant'。

questions.prompt: Social Assistant: Jane 10: _________
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'her surname is Yentob. Y-E-N-T-O-B'，英式拼读题型。

transcript.speaker: MAN
transcript.en: Hello?
transcript.zh: 你好？

transcript.speaker: WOMAN
transcript.en: Oh, hello. I’m inquiring about the social programme.
transcript.zh: 哦，你好。我想咨询一下社交活动安排。

transcript.speaker: MAN
transcript.en: Hello. Yes, my name's David. I'm the social organiser here at the English Language Centre.
transcript.zh: 你好。是的，我叫大卫。我是英语语言中心的社交活动组织者。

transcript.speaker: WOMAN
transcript.en: Ah, right. I’m a new student here—I only arrived two days ago—so I wanted to find out what kind of activities you organise.
transcript.zh: 啊好的。我是新来的学生——两天前刚到——所以想了解一下你们组织什么样的活动。

transcript.speaker: MAN
transcript.en: Well, we have a social programme pretty much every month. We try to arrange five trips on weekends, sometimes more.
transcript.zh: 我们基本上每个月都有社交计划。我们尽量在周末安排五次出行，有时更多。

transcript.speaker: WOMAN
transcript.en: Oh, that sounds good. What sort of places do you visit?
transcript.zh: 听起来不错。你们通常去什么样的地方？

transcript.speaker: MAN
transcript.en: Well, we usually pick places of historical interest or places with a good variety of shopping. And we always make sure there are guided tours available if people want them.
transcript.zh: 我们通常挑选历史名胜，或者购物便利丰富的地方 [Q1]。如果大家需要，我们始终确保有专业导游陪同 [Q2]。

transcript.speaker: WOMAN
transcript.en: Excellent. And how much do the trips cost?
transcript.zh: 太棒了。这些旅行要花费多少呢？

transcript.speaker: MAN
transcript.en: Usually somewhere between £5.00 and £15.00 per person, depending on where we go and how far it is.
transcript.zh: 通常在每人 5 到 15 英镑之间，取决于去哪里和路程多远。

transcript.speaker: WOMAN
transcript.en: Right. I see. Do you ever organise special trips for groups?
transcript.zh: 明白了。你们会为团体组织特殊活动吗？

transcript.speaker: MAN
transcript.en: Yes, we do. If we have more than 12 people wanting to go somewhere special, we can sometimes arrange something.
transcript.zh: 会的。如果有超过 12 个人想去某个特别的地方，我们有时可以做出安排 [Q3]。

transcript.speaker: WOMAN
transcript.en: That’s great. What time do the trips usually set off?
transcript.zh: 太好了。旅行通常几点出发？

transcript.speaker: MAN
transcript.en: Normally, departure is quite early—around 8.30 a.m.—and we aim to return by 6.00 p.m. in the evening.
transcript.zh: 通常出发很早——大约早上 8:30——并争取在晚上 6:00 之前返回。

transcript.speaker: WOMAN
transcript.en: Perfect. And how do we go about booking a place?
transcript.zh: 太好了。那我们怎么预订位置呢？

transcript.speaker: MAN
transcript.en: You need to sign your name on the notice board—it's just outside the main office. You need to do that at least three days in advance.
transcript.zh: 你需要在公告栏上签名报名 [Q4]——它就在主办公室外面。你至少需要提前三天报名。

transcript.speaker: WOMAN
transcript.en: Right, I'll look out for it. Is there anything else I should know?
transcript.zh: 好的，我会留意的。还有其他我需要了解的吗？

transcript.speaker: MAN
transcript.en: Well, you can check the details of the upcoming weekend trips on the board too. For example, looking at the schedule for this month... on the 13th of February, we're going to St Ives, and there are 16 seats available, with an optional extra trip to the Hepworth Museum.
transcript.zh: 你也可以在公告板上查看即将到来的周末旅行详情。例如本月的安排……2月13日我们要去圣艾夫斯 [Q5]，有 16 个名额，可自选参观赫普沃斯博物馆。

transcript.speaker: WOMAN
transcript.en: Oh, I'd love to go there. What about the other trips?
transcript.zh: 哦，我很想去那里。那其他旅行呢？

transcript.speaker: MAN
transcript.en: On the 16th of February, we’re heading down to London. We've booked a coach for 45 people, and... let's see... the optional extra there is a visit to the Tower of London.
transcript.zh: 2月16日我们要去伦敦。预订了一辆 45 人的大巴，自选项目是参观伦敦塔 [Q6]。

transcript.speaker: WOMAN
transcript.en: Sounds interesting. Any others?
transcript.zh: 听起来很有趣。还有其他的吗？

transcript.speaker: MAN
transcript.en: Yes, on the 3rd of March, we're going to Bristol—transporting 18 people—and people can choose to visit the S.S. Great Britain. Then on the 18th of March, we’re visiting Salisbury, taking 50 people with an option to see Stonehenge. And finally, on the 23rd of March, we’re going to Bath with a group of 16, with an optional extra visit to the American Museum.
transcript.zh: 有的，3月3日我们要去布里斯托 [Q7]——载客 18 人——大家可以选择参观大不列颠号蒸汽船。3月18日去索尔兹伯里，50人名额并可选看巨石阵。最后3月23日我们组织16人去巴斯，自选项目是美国博物馆 [Q8]。

transcript.speaker: WOMAN
transcript.en: That’s a really full programme! Who should I speak to if I have any questions?
transcript.zh: 日程真的很丰富！如果我有问题该联系谁？

transcript.speaker: MAN
transcript.en: You can either read the student newspaper or talk directly to our Social Assistant, Jane—her surname is Yentob, spelled Y-E-N-T-O-B.
transcript.zh: 你可以阅读学生校报 [Q9]，或者直接咨询我们的社交助理简，她的姓是 Yentob（Y-E-N-T-O-B）[Q10]。

transcript.speaker: WOMAN
transcript.en: Great, thank you very much for your help.
transcript.zh: 太好了，非常感谢你的帮助。

sections.title: Section 2: Riverside Industrial Village
sections.instruction:
Questions 11-13: Complete the sentences below. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
Questions 14-20: Label the plan below. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS for each answer.
sections.intro_text:
RIVERSIDE INDUSTRIAL VILLAGE

11. Riverside Village was a good place to start an industry because it had water, raw materials and fuels such as: [blank] and [blank].
12. The metal industry was established at Riverside Village by: [blank] who lived in the area.
13. There were over: [blank] water-powered mills in the area in the eighteenth century.

PLAN LABELLING (Questions 14-20):
• 14: [blank] Road
• 15: The [blank]
• 16: The [blank]
• 17: The [blank]
• 18: The [blank]
• 19: The [blank]
• 20: The [blank] for the workers

questions.prompt: fuels such as 11: _________ (coal, firewood in either order)
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'fuels such as coal and firewood'，煤炭与木柴。
questions.location: fuels such as coal and firewood

questions.prompt: The metal industry was established by 12: _________
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'first established here by local craftsmen who lived in the area'。
questions.location: first established here by local craftsmen

questions.prompt: There were over 13: _________ water-powered mills in the area
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'there were over 160 water-powered mills operating in the surrounding area'。

questions.prompt: 14: _________ Road (Entrance road next to Car Park)
questions.explanation: 录音地图方位提示：Woodside Road。

questions.prompt: Plan 15: The _________ (just past the toilets on the left)
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'past the toilets on our left, we come to the old Ticket Office'，售票处。
questions.location: come to the old Ticket Office

questions.prompt: Plan 16: The _________ (just behind 15)
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'Just behind that, slightly to the east, is the Gift Shop'，礼品店。

questions.prompt: Plan 17: The _________ (workshop with heavy machinery)
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'you'll reach the Main Workshop, where the heavy machinery is'。

questions.prompt: Plan 18: The _________ (adjoining the workshop for finished goods)
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'Adjoining the workshop is the Showroom, where finished metal goods were once exhibited'，陈列室/展厅。

questions.prompt: Plan 19: The _________ (serves hot drinks and meals)
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'right next to the showroom is the Café, which serves hot drinks'，咖啡厅。

questions.prompt: Plan 20: The _________ for the workers (on far eastern edge)
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'you can see the restored cottages where the original factory workers and their families used to live'，工人居所小屋。

transcript.speaker: TOUR GUIDE
transcript.en: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Riverside Industrial Village. My name is Tom, and I’m your guide today.
transcript.zh: 大家早上好，欢迎来到河畔工业村。我叫汤姆，是大家今天的向导。

transcript.speaker: TOUR GUIDE
transcript.en: Riverside Village was a very successful manufacturing centre in the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries. It was chosen as a good place to start an industry primarily because it had an abundant supply of water, raw materials, and fuels such as coal and firewood.
transcript.zh: 河畔村在19世纪和20世纪初是非常繁荣的制造中心。它之所以被选为工业基地，主要是因为它拥有丰富的水资源、原材料以及煤炭和木柴等燃料 [Q11]。

transcript.speaker: TOUR GUIDE
transcript.en: The metal industry itself was first established here by local craftsmen who lived in the area and utilized the natural resources. Because the river flows quite fast through this valley, it provided brilliant energy generation, and records show there were over 160 water-powered mills operating in the surrounding area during the eighteenth century.
transcript.zh: 这里的金属工业最早是由当地居住的工匠建立的 [Q12]。因为河流湍急，提供了出色的水力发电，记录显示在18世纪周围有超过160个水力磨坊在运转 [Q13]。

transcript.speaker: TOUR GUIDE
transcript.en: Now, if you look at your map, I’ll point out where we are. We are standing right here by the entrance on Woodside Road near The Works Office.
transcript.zh: 现在看你们的地图，我们正站在伍德赛德路（Woodside Road）[Q14] 入口处附近的工作办公室旁。

transcript.speaker: TOUR GUIDE
transcript.en: If we walk straight down the main path past the toilets on our left, we come to the old Ticket Office, which is now used to sell guidebooks and souvenirs.
transcript.zh: 沿着主路往前走，经过左侧的洗手间，就是旧售票处（Ticket Office）[Q15]。

transcript.speaker: TOUR GUIDE
transcript.en: Just behind that, slightly to the east, is the Gift Shop. If you continue along the path past the central courtyard, you’ll reach the Main Workshop, where the heavy machinery is still on display.
transcript.zh: 售票处正后方稍偏东是礼品店（Gift Shop）[Q16]。沿路穿过中央庭院，就会到达主车间（Main Workshop）[Q17]。

transcript.speaker: TOUR GUIDE
transcript.en: Adjoining the workshop is the Showroom, where finished metal goods were once exhibited to prospective buyers. Right next to the showroom is the Café, which serves hot drinks, snacks, and light meals.
transcript.zh: 与车间相连的是展厅（Showroom）[Q18]。紧挨着展厅的是咖啡馆（Café）[Q19]。

transcript.speaker: TOUR GUIDE
transcript.en: Finally, on the far eastern edge of the village, past the water wheel, you can see the restored cottages where the original factory workers and their families used to live.
transcript.zh: 最后在村子最东边，经过水车，可以看到修复后的工人工棚小屋（cottages）[Q20]。

sections.title: Section 3: Melanie and Dr Johnson Discussion
sections.instruction:
Questions 21-22: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.
Questions 23-27: What recommendation does Dr Johnson make about the journal articles? Choose from A-G.
Questions 28-30: Label the chart below. Choose from A-H.
sections.intro_text:
TUTOR DISCUSSION ABOUT ASSIGNMENT

Questions 21-22:
21. Melanie says she has not started the assignment because...
22. The lecturer says that reasonable excuses for extensions are...

Questions 23-27 (Journal Articles):
A: must read | B: useful | C: limited value | D: read first section | E: read research methods | F: read conclusion | G: don't read
• 23. Jackson: [blank]
• 24. Roberts: [blank]
• 25. Morris: [blank]
• 26. Cooper: [blank]
• 27. Forster: [blank]

Questions 28-30 (Reasons for changing accommodation chart):
• 28. Bar 2: [blank]
• 29. Bar 5: [blank]
• 30. Bar 6: [blank]

questions.prompt: 21. Melanie says she has not started the assignment because
options: A. she was doing work for another course.
B. it was a really big assignment.
C. she hasn't spent time in the library.
questions.explanation: 录音原文：Melanie 因为忙于另外一门课程的工作而耽误了开始写作。

questions.prompt: 22. The lecturer says that reasonable excuses for extensions are
questions.explanation: 导师表示合理的延期理由通常需要有医生证明等因病或突发事故。

questions.prompt: 23. Jackson:
questions.explanation: 导师建议：'just look at the part on the research methodology—how they did it' -> 选择 E (read research methods)。

questions.prompt: 24. Roberts:
questions.explanation: 导师说 Roberts 的文章如果有时间可以读读，是 useful 的。
questions.location: worth reading if you have time

questions.prompt: 25. Morris:
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'No, I wouldn't bother with that one. It's out of date now.' -> G (don't read)。

questions.prompt: 26. Cooper:
questions.explanation: Cooper 的文章重点看背景与结论部分。
questions.location: Cooper is good on the background

questions.prompt: 27. Forster:
questions.explanation: Forster 的参考价值有限/模型参考。

questions.prompt: 28. Bar 2 on reasons for moving chart:
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'Bar number two? That's about the environment. People wanting to live in a greener area.' -> B。
questions.location: Bar number two? That's about the environment

questions.prompt: 29. Bar 5 on reasons for moving chart:
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'That's due to transport - proximity to the city or to work' -> G (transport)。

questions.prompt: 30. Bar 6 on reasons for moving chart:
questions.explanation: 录音原文提到关于邻里环境与噪音等考量。

transcript.speaker: MELANIE
transcript.en: Excuse me, Dr Johnson. May I speak to you for a minute?
transcript.zh: 打扰一下约翰逊博士。我可以和您谈一两分钟吗？

transcript.speaker: DR JOHNSON
transcript.en: Of course, Melanie. Come in. How can I help you?
transcript.zh: 当然可以，梅兰妮。请进。有什么能帮你的？

transcript.speaker: MELANIE
transcript.en: I'm sorry to disturb you. I've only just started to write my assignment and I'm stuck. It's the question on housing and population trends.
transcript.zh: 很抱歉打扰您。我刚刚开始写作业就卡住了。是关于住房和人口趋势的题目。

transcript.speaker: DR JOHNSON
transcript.en: Yes, you had flu last week, didn't you? What did you get for your first assignment?
transcript.zh: 是的，你上周得了流感对吧？你第一次作业得了多少分？

transcript.speaker: MELANIE
transcript.en: I got 87%. Is there any chance I can get an extension?
transcript.zh: 我拿了 87 分。我有机会申请延期交作业吗？[Q21, Q22]

transcript.speaker: DR JOHNSON
transcript.en: Well, since you did so well in your first assignment, I'm prepared to give you an extra two weeks for this one. Now, what about the reading materials?
transcript.zh: 鉴于你第一次作业表现出色，我准备为你额外延期两周。现在谈谈阅读材料吧？

transcript.speaker: DR JOHNSON
transcript.en: You should read the article by Jackson, but just look at the part on the research methodology—how they did it.
transcript.zh: 你应该读一下 Jackson 的文章，但只需要看研究方法那部分 [Q23]。

transcript.speaker: DR JOHNSON
transcript.en: Then there's Roberts—that's useful and worth reading if you have time, but not strictly necessary.
transcript.zh: 还有 Roberts 的文章——很有用，有时间的话值得一读 [Q24]。

transcript.speaker: MELANIE
transcript.en: What about Morris?
transcript.zh: Morris 的怎么样？

transcript.speaker: DR JOHNSON
transcript.en: No, I wouldn't bother with that one. It's out of date now.
transcript.zh: 不用费心读那篇了，内容已经过时了 [Q25]。

transcript.speaker: DR JOHNSON
transcript.en: Cooper and Forster are both recommended—Cooper is good on background and conclusions, while Forster has some specific models.
transcript.zh: Cooper 和 Forster 都推荐——Cooper 适合看背景与结论，Forster 有一些特定模型 [Q26, Q27]。

transcript.speaker: MELANIE
transcript.en: Could you explain the chart on page two—reasons why people change where they live?
transcript.zh: 您能解释一下第二页的图表吗——关于人们搬迁的原因？

transcript.speaker: DR JOHNSON
transcript.en: Bar number one is space. Bar number two is about the environment—people wanting a greener area. Bar number five is due to transport. And bar number six is neighbourhood noise and environment.
transcript.zh: 1号柱是空间。2号柱是环境——人们渴望更绿色的环境 [Q28]。5号柱是交通 [Q29]。6号柱是邻居噪音与社区宜居度 [Q30]。

sections.title: Section 4: The Urban Landscape
sections.instruction: Questions 31-40: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS for each answer.
sections.intro_text:
THE URBAN LANDSCAPE

Two areas of focus:
• the effect of vegetation on the urban climate
• ways of planning our 31: [blank] better

Large-scale impact of trees:
• they can make cities more or less 32: [blank]
• in summer they can make cities cooler
• they can make inland cities more 33: [blank]

Local impact of trees:
• they can make local areas:
  - more 34: [blank]
  - cooler
  - more humid
  - less windy
  - less 35: [blank]

Comparing trees and buildings:
Temperature regulation:
• trees evaporate water through their 36: [blank]
• building surfaces may reach high temperatures

Wind force:
• tall buildings cause more wind at 37: [blank] level
• trees 38: [blank] the wind force

Noise:
• trees have a small effect on traffic noise
• 39: [blank] frequency noise passes straight through trees

Important points to consider:
• trees require a lot of sunlight, water and 40: [blank] to grow

questions.prompt: ways of planning our 31: _________ better
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'ways of planning our cities better'，改善城市规划。
questions.location: ways of planning our cities better

questions.prompt: they can make cities more or less 32: _________
questions.explanation: 录音原文提到树木对大尺度风速的影响，使城市或多或少呈现 windy 特征。
questions.location: make cities more or less windy

questions.prompt: they can make inland cities more 33: _________
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'they can also make inland cities more humid'，湿润的。

questions.prompt: trees can make local areas more 34: _________
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'trees can make local areas more shady, cooler, more humid'，林荫/遮阳。

questions.prompt: trees can make local areas less 35: _________
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'less windy, and less dangerous in terms of storms'，降低暴风危险。
questions.location: less dangerous in terms of storms

questions.prompt: trees evaporate water through their 36: _________
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'Trees evaporate water through their leaves'，叶片蒸腾作用。

questions.prompt: tall buildings cause more wind at 37: _________ level
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'tall buildings cause more wind at ground level'，地面层风力增加。
questions.location: cause more wind at ground level

questions.prompt: trees 38: _________ the wind force
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'trees effectively reduce or filter the wind force'，减弱/过滤风力。
questions.location: reduce or filter the wind force

questions.prompt: 39: _________ frequency noise passes straight through trees
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'Low-frequency noise passes straight through trees'，低频噪音直接穿透树木。

questions.prompt: trees require a lot of sunlight, water and 40: _________ to grow
questions.explanation: 录音原文：'we must make sure there is enough space for their roots to grow'，生长空间。
questions.location: there is enough space for their roots

transcript.speaker: LECTURER
transcript.en: Good day, ladies and gentlemen! I have been asked today to talk to you about the urban landscape.
transcript.zh: 女士们先生们，大家好！今天应邀向大家分享关于城市景观的探讨。

transcript.speaker: LECTURER
transcript.en: There are two major areas that I will focus on in my talk: the effect of vegetation on the urban climate, and ways of planning our cities better.
transcript.zh: 我的演讲主要聚焦两个方面：植被对城市气候的影响，以及如何更好地规划我们的城市 [Q31]。

transcript.speaker: LECTURER
transcript.en: First, let's look at the large-scale impact of trees on cities. It is clear that trees can make cities more or less windy, but on a broader scale, in summer, they can make cities cooler and inland cities more humid.
transcript.zh: 首先看树木对城市的大尺度影响。树木显然能使城市或多或少具有多风特性 [Q32]，更广泛来看，夏季可使城市更凉爽，使内陆城市更湿润 [Q33]。

transcript.speaker: LECTURER
transcript.en: Now, what about the local impact? On a local level, trees can make local areas more shady, cooler, more humid, less windy, and less dangerous in terms of storms.
transcript.zh: 局部影响方面，树木能提供更多阴凉 [Q34]，降低温度，增加湿度，减小风速，并在暴风雨侵袭时降低危险性 [Q35]。

transcript.speaker: LECTURER
transcript.en: Let's compare trees with buildings when it comes to temperature regulation. Trees evaporate water through their leaves, whereas building surfaces absorb solar radiation.
transcript.zh: 对比温度调节：树木通过叶片蒸发水分实现降温 [Q36]，而建筑物表面则吸收大量太阳辐射。

transcript.speaker: LECTURER
transcript.en: In terms of wind force, tall buildings cause more wind at ground level, whereas trees effectively reduce or filter the wind force.
transcript.zh: 高层建筑会在地面形成更强风力 [Q37]，而树木则能显著减弱或过滤风力 [Q38]。

transcript.speaker: LECTURER
transcript.en: When we look at noise, low-frequency noise passes straight through trees, whereas high-frequency noise is slightly muffled.
transcript.zh: 噪音方面，低频噪音会直接穿过树木 [Q39]，而高频噪音会略微减弱。

transcript.speaker: LECTURER
transcript.en: Finally, when planting trees in a city, we must make sure there is enough space for their roots to grow without damaging infrastructure.
transcript.zh: 最后在城市绿化时，必须保证有充足的空间供根系生长，避免损坏市政设施 [Q40]。
